_om: Alla databasfrågor som Windows-appen får ställa mot användarens egna databaser (W12). Gränssnittet
anropar dem med namn (db_read och db_write i src-tauri/src/main.rs), och kan aldrig skicka egen SQL.
Rust-delen läser filen när den byggs (include_str), och dev/server.py läser samma fil.
schema körs och columns läggs till när appen startar, så att en databas från en äldre version fungerar.
moves är engångsflyttar (G3): finns rader att flytta görs först en kopia av databasfilen i datamappen (backup plus tid), sedan körs steps i en transaktion. Stegen går att köra om utan skada.

_om: G3: varje bok får ett eget id (UUID i gemener) som aldrig ändras, och kontrollsumman flyttas till
kolumnen sha256. Förut var id:t kontrollsumman. book i markeringar och bokmärken flyttas till id:t utan
att ändringstiden rörs. Synken skickar fortfarande sha256 som book_id.
moves.pending: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM books WHERE sha256 = ''
steps: UPDATE books SET sha256 = id, id = lower(hex(randomblob(4)) || '-' || hex(randomblob(2)) || '-4' || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || substr('89ab', 1 + (random() & 3), 1) || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || hex(randomblob(6))) WHERE sha256 = ''

UPDATE highlights SET book = (SELECT b.id FROM books b WHERE b.sha256 = highlights.book ORDER BY b.missing, b.added LIMIT 1) WHERE book IN (SELECT sha256 FROM books WHERE sha256 <> '') AND book NOT IN (SELECT id FROM books)

UPDATE bookmarks SET book = (SELECT b.id FROM books b WHERE b.sha256 = bookmarks.book ORDER BY b.missing, b.added LIMIT 1) WHERE book IN (SELECT sha256 FROM books WHERE sha256 <> '') AND book NOT IN (SELECT id FROM books)
INSERT INTO meta (key, value) VALUES ('legacy_book_keys_moved', '1') ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value

books_list: SELECT id, title, author, format, ext, file_name, size, added, opened, position, progress, cover, position_updated, sha256, missing, modified FROM books WHERE missing = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN opened > 0 THEN opened ELSE added END DESC
book_get: SELECT id, title, author, format, ext, file_name, size, added, opened, position, progress, cover, position_updated, sha256, missing, modified FROM books WHERE id = ?
highlights_of_book: SELECT id, book, section, start, length, text, color, note, created, updated FROM highlights WHERE book = ? AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY section, start
bookmarks_of_book: SELECT id, book, section, progression, label, created, updated FROM bookmarks WHERE book = ? AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY section, progression
words_saved: SELECT id, word, lemma, language, sentence, book, page, lookups, updated, uuid, book_id FROM saved_words WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY updated DESC
word_is_saved: SELECT 1 FROM saved_words WHERE lemma = ? AND language = ? AND deleted = 0
words_for_sync: SELECT lemma, language, word, sentence, book, page, lookups, created, updated, deleted, due, interval, ease, reps, lapses, review_updated, uuid, book_id FROM saved_words
words_for_review: SELECT id, word, lemma, language, sentence, book, page, updated, due, interval, ease, reps, lapses, review_introduced FROM saved_words WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY updated DESC
hidden_pairs_all: SELECT language, lemma, synonym FROM hidden_pairs ORDER BY lemma, synonym
books_registry: SELECT id, title, author, format, ext, file_name, size, added, opened, position, progress, cover, position_updated, sha256, missing, modified FROM books

setting_set: INSERT INTO settings (key, value) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value
book_add: INSERT INTO books (id, title, author, format, ext, file_name, size, added, cover, sha256, modified, missing) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0)
book_opened: UPDATE books SET opened = ? WHERE id = ?
book_position: UPDATE books SET position = ?, progress = ?, position_updated = ? WHERE id = ?
book_synced_position: UPDATE books SET position = ?, position_updated = ? WHERE id = ?
highlight_save: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO highlights (id, book, section, start, length, text, color, note, created, updated, deleted) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0)
highlight_delete: UPDATE highlights SET deleted = 1, updated = ? WHERE id = ?
bookmark_add: INSERT INTO bookmarks (id, book, section, progression, label, created, updated, deleted) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0)
bookmark_delete: UPDATE bookmarks SET deleted = 1, updated = ? WHERE id = ?
word_save: INSERT INTO saved_words (word, lemma, language, sentence, book, page, lookups, created, updated, uuid, book_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (lemma, language) DO UPDATE SET word = excluded.word, sentence = excluded.sentence, book = excluded.book, page = excluded.page, book_id = excluded.book_id, lookups = CASE WHEN deleted THEN 1 ELSE lookups + 1 END, created = CASE WHEN deleted THEN excluded.created ELSE created END, deleted = 0, updated = excluded.updated
word_delete_by_id: UPDATE saved_words SET deleted = 1, updated = ?, due = NULL, interval = NULL, ease = NULL, reps = NULL, lapses = NULL, review_updated = NULL, review_introduced = NULL WHERE id = ?
word_delete_by_lemma: UPDATE saved_words SET deleted = 1, updated = ?, due = NULL, interval = NULL, ease = NULL, reps = NULL, lapses = NULL, review_updated = NULL, review_introduced = NULL WHERE lemma = ? AND language = ?
word_synced: INSERT INTO saved_words (word, lemma, language, sentence, book, page, lookups, created, updated, uuid, book_id, deleted, due, interval, ease, reps, lapses, review_updated, review_introduced) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, '', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (lemma, language) DO UPDATE SET word = excluded.word, sentence = excluded.sentence, book = excluded.book, page = excluded.page, lookups = excluded.lookups, created = excluded.created, updated = excluded.updated, deleted = excluded.deleted, due = excluded.due, interval = excluded.interval, ease = excluded.ease, reps = excluded.reps, lapses = excluded.lapses, review_updated = excluded.review_updated, review_introduced = CASE WHEN excluded.due IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(review_introduced, excluded.review_introduced) END
word_review: UPDATE saved_words SET due = ?, interval = ?, ease = ?, reps = ?, lapses = ?, review_updated = ?, review_introduced = COALESCE(review_introduced, ?) WHERE lemma = ? AND language = ? AND deleted = 0
hidden_pair_add: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hidden_pairs VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
hidden_pair_remove: DELETE FROM hidden_pairs WHERE language = ? AND lemma = ? AND synonym = ?
book_missing: UPDATE books SET missing = 1 WHERE id = ?
book_new_file: UPDATE books SET sha256 = ?, title = ?, author = ?, format = ?, ext = ?, file_name = ?, size = ?, modified = ?, cover = ?, missing = 0 WHERE id = ?
book_restore: UPDATE books SET missing = 0, file_name = ?, modified = ? WHERE id = ?
